snippet.title: DELTARUNE MASTER MODE: Chapter 1 - The First Trial (RELEASE TRAILER)
snippet.description:
The first public alpha build is finally out! Lot more to come soon hopefully!
Download: https://gamebanana.com/mods/520678

Dimensional Jevil design: @SporkGal 
Dimensional Jevil sprites: Funtermore / Gamejolt

"Deltarune Master Mode" is a work in progress Deltarune difficulty mod.
The mod aims to be in similar vein to Undertale Hard Mode, and plans to continue development alongside vanilla/official Deltarune - eventually becoming a full hard mode mod for the full version of Deltarune!

[If you enjoy this: Like and subscribe! It helps out this channel a lot!]

=====

[Game Description]
Deltarune is a role-playing video game developed by Toby Fox. The player controls a teenage human, Kris, who is destined to save the world together with Susie, a monster, and Ralsei, a prince from the Dark World. During their quest to seal the "Dark Fountains" prophesied to end the world, the group meets the inhabitants of the "Dark World", some of whom try to stop them. The combat system is based on bullet hell attacks the player must dodge. Similar to Undertale, enemy encounters can be resolved peacefully or through violence.
